about: The creator's own winner picks for saved runs: run id (outputs/<run>/, kept on the machine that made it; outputs/ is not committed) and the thumbnail slots they accept as the winner. debug/rejudge.mjs re-judges every set here when given no sets. tunedOn names the judge rubric that was adjusted while looking at the set, so its score there is in-sample; a set with no tunedOn is held out and is the real test of the judge.
